about.real_time_orbit_tracking: Real-time Orbit Tracking: Track Earth-orbiting targets using Skyfield/SGP4 propagation from stored orbital elements.
about.configurable_orbital_sources_metadata_en: Configurable Orbital Sources + Metadata Enrichment: Sync orbital data from configured sources (default CelesTrak feeds) and enrich satellites/transmitters from SatNOGS APIs.
about.multi_target_tracker_instances: Multi-Target Tracker Instances: Run multiple tracker instances in parallel (target-N slots), each with independent runtime state.
about.automated_antenna_rotator_control: Automated Antenna Rotator Control: Drive connected rotators with continuous az/el updates, limit checks, and anti-thrashing retarget logic.
about.rig_control_with_doppler_correction: Rig Control with Doppler Correction: Control compatible rigs (rigctld/Hamlib paths) with RX/TX Doppler-corrected tuning during tracking.
about.sdr_hardware_support: SDR Hardware Support: RTL-SDR (USB/rtl_tcp), SoapySDR (local/remote), UHD/USRP, plus a virtual SigMF Playback SDR.
about.live_dsp_pipeline: Live DSP Pipeline: Stream IQ to FFT/waterfall, demodulators, decoders, recorders, and browser consumers through queue-based worker orchestration.
about.iq_recording_sigmf_playback: IQ Recording + SigMF Playback: Record IQ as .sigmf-data/.sigmf-meta with metadata, then replay through the same processing pipeline used for live SDR operation.
about.data_decoding_framing_protocols: Data Decoding + Framing Protocols: Decode SSTV, FSK, GFSK, GMSK, BPSK, and GNSS paths with AX.25/USP/GEOSCAN framing support in packet pipelines.
about.transcription_services: Transcription Services: Demodulated-audio transcription via Gemini Live, Deepgram, or Parakeet, with optional translation and file output.
about.scheduled_observations: Scheduled Observations: APScheduler-driven AOS/LOS orchestration for automatic start/stop of tracking, SDR, decoding, recording, and transcription tasks.
about.satdump_post_processing: SatDump Post-Processing: Optional SatDump processing for IQ recordings, including METEOR LRPT/HRPT workflows.
about.performance_monitoring: Performance Monitoring: Stream live pipeline metrics including queue utilization, throughput, drops, and component health.
about.authentication_user_management: Authentication + User Management: Built-in login with role-based access control for admins and operators.
about.interactive_solar_system_mission_targeti: Interactive Solar System + Mission Targeting: Track selected solar-system bodies and deep-space mission targets through NASA/JPL Horizons-backed vectors.
about.a_fast_python_web_framework_for_api_serv: A fast Python web framework for API services.
about.astronomy_library_for_orbital_and_celest: Astronomy library for orbital and celestial positions.
about.ephemeris_vectors_and_observer_geometry_: Ephemeris vectors and observer geometry for solar-system body tracking.
about.satellite_decoder_suite_for_weather_imag: Satellite decoder suite for weather image workflows.
about.rs_radiosonde_decoder: Radiosonde detection and telemetry decoding for RS41, DFM and M10/M20.
about.gnu_radio_modules_for_satellite_communic: GNU Radio modules for satellite communications.
about.open_source_software_defined_gnss_receiv: Open-source software-defined GNSS receiver used by the GNSS decoder path.
about.opinionated_redux_tooling_for_state_mana: Opinionated Redux tooling for state management.
about.fast_frontend_bundler_and_dev_server: Fast frontend bundler and dev server.
about.client_runtime_for_realtime_socket_io_co: Client runtime for realtime Socket.IO communications.
about.open_source_map_rendering_engine_used_fo: Open-source map rendering engine used for 2D and globe map views.
about.orbital_element_feeds_used_for_target_sy: Orbital element feeds used for target synchronization.
about.ephemeris_vectors_and_observer_geometry_: Ephemeris vectors and observer geometry for solar-system targets.
about.realtime_speech_to_text_provider_for_dem: Realtime speech-to-text provider for demodulated audio.
about.realtime_transcription_provider_with_opt: Realtime transcription provider with optional translation workflows.
about.parakeet_transcription: Self-hosted speech transcription for demodulated audio.
about.optional_translation_for_deepgram_transc: Optional translation for Deepgram and Parakeet transcription outputs.
about.airspy_airspyhf_native_worker_support_ai: Airspy / AirspyHF+ native worker support (AirspyHF+ currently untested)
about.soapysdr_devices_locally_or_through_soap: SoapySDR devices locally or through SoapyRemote: RTL-SDR, Airspy, HackRF, HydraSDR, LimeSDR, PlutoSDR, UHD/USRP, and SDRplay (RSP series)
about.uhd_usrp_radios_via_a_uhd_worker: UHD/USRP radios via a UHD worker

about.need_another_soapysdr_device_open_a_gith: Need another SoapySDR device? Open a GitHub issue and request support.
about.intro: Open-source, browser-based application for tracking satellites and celestial targets, controlling station hardware, and receiving, decoding, and recording SDR signals.
